item.title: Roche Xofluza Licensing Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Roche signed a licensing deal with the Medicines Patent Pool to allow generic manufacturing of Xofluza (baloxavir marboxil) in 129 low- and middle-income countries, expanding global access to the influenza antiviral.
  • MoAs: Cap-dependent endonuclease inhibitor – blocks influenza virus mRNA synthesis by inhibiting the cap-dependent endonuclease activity of the viral polymerase.
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma

item.title: Mentari/Inmed Migraine Merger
item.description:
• Summary: Mentari and Inmed have agreed to merge, forming a combined company focused on developing novel migraine therapies. The deal aims to consolidate their pipelines and resources to accelerate drug development.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioPharma Dive

item.title: Paragon Offshoot Reverse Merger Migraine
item.description:
• Summary: An offshoot of Paragon has chosen a reverse merger to advance its migraine drug candidates. This financial maneuver allows the company to access public markets and fund development without a traditional IPO.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Incyte AI Drug Discovery Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Incyte has signed a deal with Edison Scientific to train artificial intelligence models for drug discovery. The collaboration aims to leverage AI to accelerate the identification of novel therapeutic targets and compounds.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech

item.title: Novo Nordisk R&D Streamlining
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Nordisk's research chief states that the company's streamlined R&D operations are speeding up drug discovery. The reorganization allows for more efficient decision-making and faster progression of pipeline candidates.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Acceleron Leaders IPF Biotech
item.description:
• Summary: Former leaders of Acceleron, along with Westlake, have launched a new biotechnology company focused on idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). The startup aims to develop novel therapies for this rare lung disease.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Regeneron Parabilis Deal
item.description:
• Summary: Regeneron has entered into a deal with Parabilis to utilize Helic-on conjugates technology. The partnership is intended to advance the development of next-generation antibody-drug conjugates.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: Full Life Technologies Funding
item.description:
• Summary: Full Life Technologies has raised $150 million in a funding round, with significant participation from Quince. The proceeds will be used to advance the company's pipeline of targeted radiopharmaceuticals.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Nourish Virtual Nutrition Care Funding
item.description:
• Summary: Nourish, a virtual nutrition care platform, has raised $100 million in funding. The company plans to expand its services and technology to provide personalized nutrition guidance to patients.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: Takeda Layoffs
item.description:
• Summary: Takeda conducted significant layoffs in May, contributing to a year-over-year increase in job cuts across the biopharma industry. The restructuring is part of the company's ongoing cost-saving measures.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: BioSpace
